eiketsuden.moneyHelp: The original game caps money at 10,000 when loading a save.
eiketsuden.classHelp: The game derives troop capacity, combat values and available tactics from the class and level after reloading.
eiketsuden.itemsHelp: Each of the eight slots can be replaced or emptied. Duplicate items are allowed. The game may group items differently in its display.
eiketsuden.troopsHelp: The game derives troop capacity from class and level and can replenish troops when entering battle. A stored count does not override that capacity; edit the class or level instead.
eiketsuden.baseHelp: Fixed abilities come from the uploaded game's resource data. They are not stored in this save and cannot be changed by this editor.
